channel.title: Potomac Local News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Potomac Local News (potomaclocal.com)

item.title: Stafford Schools Push Back On Kraken Power Line
item.description: Stafford County School Board members are urging state lawmakers to restore stronger protections for schools as Dominion Energy advances plans for a 500-kilovolt transmission line that would run through the county.

item.title: Council OKs Princess Anne Townhomes
item.description: Fredericksburg City Council unanimously approved a mixed-use infill project on Princess Anne Street that will bring new townhomes, restore a historic gas station, and add a public pedestrian link to the city’s riverfront trail system.

item.title: Major Road Projects Advance in Prince William’s Six-Year Capital Plan
item.description: Prince William County is dedicating the largest share of its proposed $1.56 billion six-year Capital Improvement Program to transportation, with major road projects moving forward and new fiscal strategies aimed at saving taxpayers millions.

item.title: Fredericksburg Planning Director Announces Departure
item.description: Fredericksburg’s top planning official is leaving his post, and the Planning Commission is welcoming a new member following a closely divided City Council vote.

item.title: Planet Novak Lands in Spotsylvania Towne Center
item.description: A new arcade in Spotsylvania Towne Centre is flipping the script on traditional gaming — replacing joysticks and tokens with skill-based claw machines designed to let players walk away winners.

item.title: Fredericksburg Burger Spot Embraces Winter Igloos
item.description: Outdoor igloos are attracting customers at Eats Burger Joint in Fredericksburg, even during record-low temperatures along Lafayette Boulevard.

item.title: City Schools Seek 7 Percent Pay Raise
item.description: Fredericksburg City Public Schools has proposed a $68.4 million operating budget for fiscal year 2027, a 5.8% increase, as the division works to address ongoing academic gaps highlighted in its latest Standards of Learning results.

item.title: Fredericksburg Leaders Urge Traffic Feedback
item.description: Fredericksburg City Council is urging residents to take part in a regional transportation survey that will help shape road, transit, and trail priorities through 2055.

item.title: New 765 kV Line Ties To Stafford Project
item.description: Dominion Energy says a new 765-kilovolt transmission line planned across Central Virginia will feed power into the same grid corridor tied to the proposed Kracken Loop project, which Dominion now calls the North Anna to Bristers line, that runs through Stafford County.

item.title: Forest Park, Woodbridge students walk out
item.description: Students at at least two Prince William County high schools walked out of class Friday morning as part of a broader protest tied to federal immigration enforcement policies, according to school officials.
